title: Improving Context-Shift Robustness of Convolutional Networks via Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy
abstract: arXiv:2611.08157v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image classification models often encounter objects in diverse and unpredictable contexts at test time, which may differ substantially from those seen during training. This phenomenon, termed context shift, exposes a key fragility in neural networks: when models rely on non-causal contextual cues for prediction, shifts in context can lead to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose a novel training framework to improve the robustness of convolutional neural networks under context shift. Our approach leverages spatial feature attribution to guide models toward making predictions that rely less on contextual regions and more on object-relevant features. As a first step, recognizing a theoretical limitation of existing feature attribution methods we introduce a new variant, ContrastiveCAMs, which produces more faithful attribution maps of model predictions. Building on ContrastiveCAMs, we further propose Context-Regu

translated_title: 通过上下文正则化交叉熵提升卷积网络的上下文偏移鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 图像分类模型在测试时常常会遇到处于多样且不可预测背景中的物体，这些背景可能与训练时所见的大不相同。这种现象被称为“上下文偏移”（context shift），它揭示了神经网络的一个关键脆弱性：当模型依赖非因果的上下文线索进行预测时，上下文的变化会导致显著的性能下降。本文提出了一种新颖的训练框架，以提升卷积神经网络在上下文偏移下的鲁棒性。我们的方法利用空间特征归因来引导模型做出更少依赖上下文区域、更多依赖物体相关特征的预测。作为第一步，我们识别出现有特征归因方法的一个理论局限，并由此引入了一种新变体 ContrastiveCAMs，它能够生成更忠实反映模型预测的归因图。在 ContrastiveCAMs 的基础上，我们进一步提出了上下文正则化交叉熵（Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy）训练方法。
tldr: 本文提出新的特征归因方法 ContrastiveCAMs，并在此基础上构建上下文正则化交叉熵训练框架，通过引导模型减少对上下文区域的依赖、更多关注物体本身的特征，从而显著提升卷积神经网络在上下文偏移场景下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ContrastiveCAMs, a more faithful feature attribution method, and builds upon it a Context-Regularized Cross-Entropy training framework that improves the robustness of convolutional networks under context shift by steering predictions away from contextual regions toward object-relevant features.
